description: This file defines the PlayerActivity class responsible for video playback in an Android TV application using Media3 ExoPlayer. It includes methods for starting the activity, initializing, and releasing the player, and handling lifecycle events.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages video playback using ExoPlayer, handling lifecycle to initialize and release media resources, and providing a static method to start playback given a URL.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Static method to launch PlayerActivity with a specified video URL.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to set up the UI and initialize views.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method to initialize the ExoPlayer instance.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method to release the ExoPlayer resources.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle method to ensure player is released when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Creates and configures the ExoPlayer, setting the media item from intent extras.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events; currently delegates to super but can be customized for key handling.
